title: Mission manifest
description: manifest.json in a campaign mission, scenario or tutorial folder.

$schema.title: Schema
$schema.description: Path or URL of the JSON Schema for this file, for editor autocomplete and errors. The client ignores it.

formatVersion.title: Format version
formatVersion.description: Version of the content format this file follows. Leave it out for version 1. A client that supports an older version reports the content as needing a newer client. This client supports version 1.

missionId.title: Mission id
missionId.description: Id of the mission, scenario or tutorial. Must equal its folder name, and for a campaign mission its key in `missions`. Stays the same once released.

entryPoint.title: Entry point
entryPoint.description: Lua file the mission starts from, relative to this folder.

mapName.title: Map
mapName.description: Name of the map the mission is played on, as the engine names it.

image.title: Image
image.description: Image file shown for the mission. A campaign mission's is in the campaign's shared/media/ folder, a scenario's or tutorial's in its own media/ folder.

backgroundImage.title: Background image
backgroundImage.description: Image file shown behind the mission. A campaign mission's is in the campaign's shared/media/ folder, a scenario's or tutorial's in its own media/ folder.

config.title: Mission configs
config.description: The mission config files, relative to this folder: a default, and optionally a config per player count.

default.title: Default config
default.description: Mission config used for any player count without its own, relative to this folder.

numPlayers.title: Configs by player count
numPlayers.description: Mission config for a number of human players, keyed by that number, such as "2".

^[1-9][0-9]*$.title: File
^[1-9][0-9]*$.description: Path of a file, relative to the folder this file is in. It must stay inside that folder.

compatibility.title: Compatibility
compatibility.description: Engine and game pairs this content has been tested with. Each entry pairs one engine with its games, and only those pairs count. List each engine once. Required for a scenario or tutorial. A campaign mission leaves it out and uses the campaign's.

items.title: Compatible engine and games
items.description: One engine version and the game versions that work with it.

engineVersion.title: Engine version
engineVersion.description: Exact engine version, as the client names installed engines. Rapid tags and wildcards are not accepted.

gameVersions.title: Game versions
gameVersions.description: Every game version that works with this engine version. A game listed here pairs with this engine only.

items.title: Game version
items.description: Exact game version, the full version string of the game archive. Rapid tags such as `byar:test` are not accepted.
